label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The bunks, lockers, wire enclosure, table and chair, two-tone pillar, benches, ventilator, overhead services and right-wall fixtures establish the corresponding ship compartment.
Left-side furnishings, rear bunks and lockers, central enclosure and foreground right pillar retain the main spatial ordering, although the aisle is substantially more open.
Furniture and structural elements retain broadly plausible relative sizes. Room clearance and the tall exposed bunk posts are exaggerated but do not invalidate their recognizable functions.
Reddish flooring, cream walls, dark frames, pale bedding, green benches and the red wall fixture preserve the principal color contrasts despite blocky simplification.
Overhead illumination keeps the authored scene legible with coherent shadows. Heavy rendering noise reduces quality but does not conceal the major contents.
Complementary views show volumetric furniture, cylindrical posts, bedding thickness and changing occlusion around the enclosure, establishing genuine three-dimensional construction.

Actual mesh objects provide separately addressable architecture, bedding, cabinets and structural rods, with nonempty geometry, parent chains and assigned shader materials. These are substantive meshes beneath the grouping empties.

dimension_scores.evidence: The main compartment identity is recognizable, but the spacious, sparse reconstruction loses much of the reference's crowded industrial character.
Frames and furniture have recognizable supporting structures, but lockers visibly lack floor support and the chair back appears disconnected from the seat.
The major palette and dark-versus-light organization correspond well; rectangular bedding, chair and safety fixture simplify characteristic silhouettes.
Heavy image noise, rigid slab bedding, simplified fittings and unsupported furniture reduce credibility despite consistent overall shading.
Principal left/right and foreground/background relationships survive, but excessive empty floor and separation of furnishings weaken the reference's compact layout.
Furniture sizes remain interpretable, while room clearance, bunk-post extensions and the relatively small work area depart from the reference balance.
Lighting is readable and shadows convey depth, but pervasive sampling noise and limited surface differentiation weaken the material presentation.
Most major object categories are present across the views, including both benches and the ventilator. Service fittings, enclosure detail and machinery articulation are substantially simplified.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
